config.label: Optional JSON map of Colber service base URLs
config.description: Optional JSON map of Colber service base URLs. Defaults to local ports 14001/14011/14021/14031/14041/14051. For the hosted Colber API, use api.colber.dev path-based URLs.

config.label: Optional bearer token forwarded to the backend services
config.description: Optional bearer token forwarded to the backend services. Leave empty for unauthenticated local development.

config.label: pino log level for stderr output (stdout is reserved for MCP JSON-RPC)
config.description: pino log level for stderr output (stdout is reserved for MCP JSON-RPC). One of: trace, debug, info, warn, error. Defaults to info.
